items.title: Asset freshness with fresh/stale badge and automatic watchdog
items.summary: The `// freshness <window>` annotation on pipeline scripts now shows a live fresh/stale verdict on the pipeline graph, emerald when the last successful run completed within the window and amber when it is stale or has never run.
